name: The Green Hills of Stranglethorn

meta.next: Chapter I, Chapter II, Chapter III, Chapter IV

summary: Across Stranglethorn Vale, loose pages from Hemet Nesingwary's novel lie scattered through the jungle. Barnil Stonepot asks you to gather them into four chapters and return them.

sections.title: A Scattered Manuscript
sections.body: At the expedition camp, Barnil Stonepot is troubled after Welcome to the Jungle. While he proofread Hemet Nesingwary's draft, a gale snatched its loose pages and flung them into the wild. Barnil recovered many, but others remain lost in the brush. He needs you to find them and assemble Chapter I, Chapter II, Chapter III, and Chapter IV before Nesingwary learns what happened.

sections.title: Preserving the Hunter's Tale
sections.body: Once you return all four chapters, Barnil can avoid an unpleasant confrontation with Nesingwary. He hopes the restored manuscript will soon reach libraries across the world.

faq.q: Who wrote The Green Hills of Stranglethorn?
aliases: author of green hills of stranglethorn
faq.answer: Hemet Nesingwary, leader of the expedition, wrote the novel and entrusted its draft to Barnil Stonepot for proofreading.
A powerful gust swept through the hunting camp as Barnil reviewed the manuscript and scattered loose pages across the jungle.

faq.q: What is needed to finish the manuscript?
faq.answer: Gather the scattered pages, assemble Chapter I, Chapter II, Chapter III, and Chapter IV, then bring the complete set to Barnil.

faq.q: Where did this assignment come from?
aliases: how do i get this quest
faq.answer: Barnil offers this work at the expedition camp in Stranglethorn Vale after you complete Welcome to the Jungle.

faq.q: What does Barnil intend to do with the restored novel?
faq.answer: Barnil hopes the restored manuscript will reach libraries across the world. Its return will also spare him Nesingwary's anger.
